items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: But to go out on the road with his band which we did, he’d keep going 1-2-3-4 without even getting a beat going.

ctx.x: I think you were on that. It’s a great album.

Yeah he was a talented writer all right. But it was an interesting personality. Kind of dry and his tempos were very weird. On the records we would do pretty well. We’d finally get a tempo that worked. But to go out on the road with his band which we did, he’d keep going 1-2-3-4 without even getting a beat going. You know every night, I mean you’d kind of hear him do something. He’d just say 1-2-3-4 [scats]. Sometimes it would be slow, or it would have no punch and would almost be dying right there. And they…
Boost it up to where it’s supposed to be.
